central_invariant: In an ephemeral CI PostgreSQL database, fixture grant consumption and its receipt are written atomically in the same transaction; no separate handoff session can verify a receipt until that transaction commits, and after commit only the exact winning attempt and scope can be verified. Every actual Provider dispatch remains DENY.
db_environment: PostgreSQL 16.6 disposable GitHub Actions service; passwords published fixture-only

roles.fixture_issuer: PR310 fixture INSERT grant, cannot consume, inspect, verify
roles.fixture_consumer_311: EXECUTE consume+receipt function, no table SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE and no handoff verify
roles.fixture_handoff_311: EXECUTE verify committed receipt only; cannot consume, mutate or inspect tables
roles.fixture_admin: privileged superuser in isolated CI, can bypass; cannot claim production anti-bypass
roles.legacy_310_fixture_consumer: old unreceipted EXECUTE revoked in the #311 CI database only

consumption_proof.same_transaction: UPDATE task4_310 grant and INSERT task4_311 fixture receipt in one transaction
consumption_proof.rollback: separate DB handoff sees no committed receipt; transaction rollback removes both
consumption_proof.successful_commit: separate DB session verifies exact issuer context/wire/case/model/cost/attempt and persisted receipt SHA
consumption_proof.replay: subsequent consumers cannot re-consume; losers cannot claim receipt
consumption_proof.privileged_admin_bypass: explicitly shown in a negative CI test; not hardened against admin
consumption_proof.receipt_hash: unkeyed SHA-256 integrity only, not independently authenticated audit evidence
consumption_proof.actual_egress_gated: NO EGRESS EXISTS IN THE DEMONSTRATOR

not_proven: actual protected issuer and independently controlled grant issuance
fresh real billing caps, per-request pricing and token limits
real API sender bound to independently committed consumptions
network unknown-result reconciliation and global no-retry
new human approval and real Provider response provenance
real native VERITAS Bind and external effects
